m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, handoff. Verify handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete — task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present
postconditions.satisfied_by: CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, handoff all read. Handoff complete.

m1-session-verify.title: Verify cached sessions and finalize session set
m1-session-verify.imperative: List cache directories to confirm >=6 sessions spanning >=2 seasons including >=1 wet/messy. Document chosen sessions and rationale. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: >=6 sessions from >=2 seasons confirmed in cache; >=1 wet/red-flagged session confirmed; selection documented
postconditions.satisfied_by: 6 sessions confirmed cached: 2023 Belgian Q+R (Spa, 0a baseline), 2022 Spanish R (0a baseline), 2024 British Q+R (Silverstone, separate circuit/season), 2023 Sao Paulo R (wet/messy). 3 seasons: 2022/2023/2024. All have car_data.ff1pkl and position_data.ff1pkl.

constraints: offline cache at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/outputs/cache — no network

m2-write-script.title: Write characterize_telemetry_instruments.py
m2-write-script.imperative: Write scripts/characterize_telemetry_instruments.py in worktree. Uses offline_loader only (no get_telemetry). Measures: sampling-interval distribution, quantization step, Z-channel verdict, per-channel noise covariance. Emits per-session JSON to .agent-work/issue-447/evidence/. Read-only script. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: script exists; no get_telemetry in it; imports offline_loader; pos_data units documented in code

check.command: cd C:/Programs/f1Brainz-worktrees/cmdr-447 && py -c "import ast; src=open('scripts/characterize_telemetry_instruments.py').read(); tree=ast.parse(src); calls=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ((isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='get_telemetry') or (isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id=='get_telemetry'))]; assert len(calls)==0, f'get_telemetry called {len(calls)} times'; assert 'offline_loader' in src; print('OK: no get_telemetry calls; imports offline_loader')"

constraints: pos_data X/Y/Z in decimetres — report both dm and m

payload.cmd: cd C:/Programs/f1Brainz-worktrees/cmdr-447 && py -c "import ast; src=open('scripts/characterize_telemetry_instruments.py').read(); tree=ast.parse(src); calls=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ((isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='get_telemetry') or (isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id=='get_telemetry'))]; assert len(calls)==0, f'get_telemetry called {len(calls)} times'; assert 'offline_loader' in src; print('OK: no get_telemetry calls; imports offline_loader')"

m4-verify-evidence.title: Verify evidence numbers present and sane
m4-verify-evidence.imperative: Spot-check the JSON outputs: confirm each has sampling_interval, quantization, z_verdict, noise_covariance sections. Confirm pos_data units reported in both dm and m. Confirm Z verdict is PASS/MARGINAL/UNUSABLE. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: each JSON has required sections; Z verdict is one of PASS/MARGINAL/UNUSABLE; dm and m both reported for quantization
postconditions.satisfied_by: All 6 session JSONs verified: each has sampling_interval, quantization, z_channel_verdict, noise_covariance. Z verdict: all 30 driver-sessions PASS. dm AND m both reported for X/Y/Z quantization (1.0dm / 0.1m). Notable finding: both streams at 4.2Hz (not 240Hz/10Hz). Dropout rates: 0.1-0.3% at >1s threshold. Speed noise: ~1.3 (km/h)^2. XY noise: 19-55 dm^2.
